name: Beehive Internet
summary: Sydney dialup/web-host ISP (Breakfast Bytes Pty Limited, domains beehive.inoz.com / beehive.inoz.au; shareholder Suzanne Todd, related to Adam Todd's AHNet); static homepage persisted to ~2004.

events.details: Breakfast Bytes Pty Ltd (ACN 081 726 669); homepage 'Created 17/09/98', so existed by Sep 1998.

Static homepage (©1999 Breakfast Bytes) persisted on beehive.inoz.com to last capture 5 May 2004; content long frozen, so the operating ISP likely wound down earlier. Proposal's c. 2004 = when the host disappeared, with the caveat (now evidenced) that real retail content froze in early 2002 under parent Breakfast Bytes/INOZ. host's last capture 5 May 2004 is a frozen 'MyName'/INOZ portal unchanged since Jul 2002; last distinct Beehive retail page 20 Jan 2002.

refs.label: Last distinct Beehive-branded retail ISP page, 20 Jan 2002
From mid-2002 the homepage was this frozen static 'MyName' portal; it persisted byte-identical until the final 5 May 2004 capture, after which the host vanishes
